title: Repair deterministic AI harness lifecycle audit-evidence and independence gates
objective: Close the blocking findings in HARNESS-AO-AUTOMATION-AUDIT-001: make the lifecycle audit-evidence gate actually enforce (verify must fail-closed when audit_evidence_gaps is non-empty), require auditor/implementer agent_id independence when counting audit evidence, validate finished-run manifests against the run-manifest schema plus acceptance/integrity before they count as evidence, exclude FAIL/PARK/QUARANTINED from ACCEPTING_AUDIT_VERDICTS, validate the readiness update `from` status, and add regression tests for every closed hole.
forbidden_actions: Do not weaken any fail-closed gate or accept a FAIL/PARK/QUARANTINED auditor verdict as satisfied audit evidence.
Do not count an audit whose agent_id equals the implementer's agent_id as independent evidence.
Do not use network APIs, agents, credentials or live data sources.
Do not modify task specs, the task ledger, run manifests, or business source under src/.
